campaign_dir: <campaign directory on a file system the jobs can write>

resources.memory_mb: <memory per job in MB, from a pilot>
resources.time_limit: <walltime as HH:MM:SS, from a pilot (required for Slurm; for HTCondor it only sizes limits.max_core_hours)>

slurm.account: <account or project to charge, if your site needs one>
slurm.qos: <quality of service, if your site needs one>

htcondor.file_transfer: <shared-filesystem or transfer: whether jobs see campaign_dir>
htcondor.requirements: <pool requirement expression, if your site needs one>
htcondor.schedd: <schedd host name to bind the campaign to, or caller for the shell's _condor_SCHEDD_HOST; omit for the site mapping>
htcondor.site_attributes: <object of ClassAd attribute to string, integer or boolean, written as +Name = value (for example JobFlavour, MaxRuntime, WantOS at CERN)>

max_attempts: <attempts per chunk; leave the key out for no resubmission>

limits.max_total_jobs: <most job attempts this campaign may use, from your site and allocation>
limits.max_core_hours: <most core-hours this campaign may use; needs resources.time_limit>
